title: When Are Two SAE Latents the Same Feature?
abstract: arXiv:2611.05655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Comparing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) requires connecting feature correspondence, differences between whole dictionaries, and uncertainty from finite evaluation data. We develop a framework that connects these tasks through an energy-weighted optimal-transport plan under a specified similarity geometry. The same plan defines a dictionary-level discrepancy, decomposes it into latent contributions, and quantifies how each latent's mass is distributed across counterparts. We characterize relationships between decoder, activation, and first-order causal similarities; idealized models clarify the interpretation of splitting and absorption. For fixed trained SAEs, we derive joint asymptotic inference for transport costs and fractions, accounting for activation similarities and both energy marginals estimated from the same documents. A joint document bootstrap gives asymptotically valid simultaneous confidence bands. Experiments across four lang

translated_title: 两个SAE潜在变量何时是同一特征？
translated_abstract: 比较稀疏自编码器（SAE）需要连接特征对应关系、整个字典之间的差异，以及由有限评估数据带来的不确定性。我们开发了一个框架，通过在指定的相似性几何下的能量加权最优传输方案将这些任务联系起来。同一个传输方案定义了字典层面的差异度量，将其分解为各个潜在变量的贡献，并量化每个潜在变量的质量在其对应项之间的分布。我们刻画了解码器相似性、激活相似性与一阶因果相似性之间的关系；理想化模型澄清了对分裂（splitting）与吸收（absorption）现象的解释。对于固定的已训练SAE，我们推导了传输成本与比例的联合渐近推断方法，其中考虑了激活相似性以及从同一批文档中估计的两个能量边际。基于文档的联合自助法（bootstrap）给出了渐近有效的同步置信带。我们在四种语言上进行了实验验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于能量加权最优传输的统一框架，用于比较稀疏自编码器的特征对应关系、字典差异与统计不确定性，并提供了渐近有效的联合置信推断方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified energy-weighted optimal transport framework for comparing SAEs, connecting feature correspondence, dictionary-level discrepancies, and statistically valid joint asymptotic inference.
